claim.claim-text: 1. A treatment device, in particular for aesthetic treatment of a patient, comprising: a switching device and an energy storage device configured for providing a signal to a magnetic field generating device;

2. The device according to claim 1, wherein the radiofrequency electrode and magnetic field generating device are configured to cause heating and muscle contraction at a different time during a treatment session.

3. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the radiofrequency electrode is positioned in at least partial overlay with the magnetic field generating device according to a floor projection of the applicator.

4. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the radiofrequency electrode is a first radiofrequency electrode, wherein the device further comprises a second radiofrequency electrode, wherein the first radiofrequency electrode and the second radiofrequency electrode are positioned between the magnetic field generating device and the patient.
5. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the radiofrequency electrode is positioned closer to the patient than the magnetic field generating device.

6. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the device further comprises a power amplifier connected to the radiofrequency electrode, wherein the power amplifier is configured to provide a radiofrequency signal configured to generate a radiofrequency field having a frequency in a range of 100 kHz to 3 GHz.
7. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the radiofrequency electrodes comprises a plurality of openings.

8. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein device further comprises a gap between the radiofrequency electrode and the magnetic field generating device, wherein the gap includes air.

9. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein device further comprises a gap between the radiofrequency electrode and the magnetic field generating device, wherein the gap includes an insulating material.

10. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the treatment device comprises an applicator including the magnetic field generating device and the radiofrequency electrode, wherein the magnetic field generating device comprises a flat magnetic coil.

11. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the treatment device comprises an applicator including the magnetic field generating device and the radiofrequency electrode, wherein the applicator further comprises a bottom cover, wherein the radiofrequency electrode is positioned between the magnetic field generating device and the bottom cover.

12. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the treatment device comprises an applicator including the magnetic field generating device and the radiofrequency electrode, wherein the radiofrequency electrode is a first radiofrequency electrode, wherein device further comprises a second radiofrequency electrode, wherein the first radiofrequency electrode and the second radiofrequency electrode are positioned in at least partial overlay with the magnetic field generating device according to a floor projection of the applicator.

13. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the treatment device comprises an applicator including the magnetic field generating device and the radiofrequency electrode, wherein the applicator further comprises a handle.

14. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the treatment device comprises an applicator including the magnetic field generating device and the radiofrequency electrode, wherein the applicator comprises a concavity.
15. The device according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the treatment device comprises a main unit and a connecting tube,

wherein the treatment device comprises an applicator including the magnetic field generating device and the radiofrequency electrode, wherein the applicator is connected to the main unit by the connecting tube, wherein the main unit includes a connector configured to connect the connecting tube with the main unit, wherein the connecting tube comprises at least one wire configured to transfer a radiofrequency signal to the radiofrequency electrode, wherein the connecting tube comprises at least one wire configured to transfer a current to the magnetic field generating device.
